plan.notes: Source: Vanderbilt School of Engineering official 'Four-Year Roadmap and Checklist (2026–2027 Catalog Year) — COMPUTER SCIENCE – B.S., 120 hours' (hosted on cdn.vanderbilt.edu, the university's official CDN), which is the genuine official term-by-term sequence for this program. The document itself states the VU Undergraduate Catalog is the definitive source. Course titles and prereqs verified against Vanderbilt's official 2026–2027 Computer Science Curriculum + Prerequisite Sheets (same official CDN) and other official VUSE curriculum/prerequisite sheets for 2026–2027. Transcription method: roadmap PDF read directly, transcribed term-by-term by an agent; elective categories (Liberal Arts Core, Open Elective, CS Depth, Technical Elective, CS Project) transcribed exactly as the roadmap places them and marked as student-choice slots. CS Depth = 15 hours (CS 3000+ except CS 3262, selected ECE courses per catalog). Technical electives = 6 hours. CS Project = one of CS 3862, 3892, 4239, 4249, 4269, 4279, 4287, 4289, 4359. ES 2100W satisfies the writing (W) component. CS 1151 (Computers and Ethics) doubles as Liberal Arts Core, per the roadmap. Calculus-variant sequences (e.g., MATH 2500/2501 track) and statistics alternatives (MATH 2810/3640) exist per the curriculum sheet; the roadmap's accelerated sequence (MATH 1300/1301/2300, 2820, 2410) is what is transcribed. No invented courses; all requirements are from official Vanderbilt documents.
